name: San Bartolo Murals (Las Pinturas)
notes: Saturno, Stuart and Beltrán, "Early Maya Writing at San Bartolo, Guatemala," Science 311 (2006): earliest secure Maya hieroglyphic text, radiocarbon-dated via associated carbonized wood to c. 300-200 BCE. Already shows a mature, fully developed script with no obvious transitional forms linking back to Olmec symbols.
